blocks.text: Bryson Berard's Inspirational Journey

blocks.html:
Bryson Berard’s journey to founding In The Light Roofing is a testament to dedication, faith, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. Established in 2017 in the heart of Lehigh Valley, Bryson’s vision was to create a roofing company that transcended the norm. Driven by a lifelong passion for roofing and an unyielding strength drawn from his faith, family, and friends, Bryson set out to infuse every project with integrity, quality, and a sense of community.

In The Light Roofing quickly became more than just a service provider; it became a symbol of trust and reliability. Bryson and his team are not just roofers; they are guardians of comfort and safety, understanding that a roof is not merely a structure but a sanctuary for those beneath it. With each shingle laid, they weave a promise of durability, efficiency, and aesthetic appeal, ensuring that clients feel not only protected but also valued.

The company’s commitment extends beyond roofing. In The Light Roofing stands as a beacon of generosity, consistently supporting local causes and strengthening the community that has embraced and supported them. This philanthropic spirit is woven into the very fabric of the company, illustrating that success is not just measured in roofs repaired or installed but in lives positively impacted.

Bryson’s leadership and the team’s craftsmanship have earned accolades and trust across Lehigh Valley, with glowing reviews and numerous referrals speaking volumes of their dedication. Clients don’t just get a roofing contractor; they gain a lifelong partner, a protector, and a friend. In The Light Roofing’s story is one of resilience, innovation, and unwavering commitment to excellence, setting a new standard in the roofing industry and inspiring others to believe that with faith, integrity, and hard work, any dream is within reach.

blocks.title: Persistent Leaks and Water Stains
blocks.html: One of the most telling signs that your roof requires attention is the presence of persistent leaks and water stains on your ceiling or walls. Our skilled team at In the Light Roofing excels at identifying the source of leaks and providing solutions that prevent further damage.

blocks.title: Damaged Shingles
blocks.html: Damaged, cracked, or curled shingles are clear indicators of potential roof issues. In the Lehigh Valley, we specialize in shingle roof repairs, ensuring the structural integrity and aesthetic appeal of your roof are fully restored.

blocks.title: Sagging Roof Deck
blocks.html: A sagging roof deck can point to underlying structural issues. Timely repairs by In the Light Roofing not only prevent further damage but also ensure the stability of your entire roofing structure.

blocks.title: Granule Loss in Gutters
blocks.html: Excessive granules in your gutters suggest deteriorating shingles. At In the Light Roofing, our roof repair services include addressing granule loss, extending the lifespan of your roof, and enhancing its resilience against the elements.

items.name: Christian S
items.text: I had 2 jobs with In The Light Roofing. They responded to estimates to replace my roof on a townhouse I rent and to fix a leak related to a vent pipe on my home. Both jobs were completed timely and with exceptional quality. Before and after pictures were taken and they spent time reviewing the completed job. Prices were reasonable and they know roofs. I will be calling them in a few years to replace the roof on my current home.

items.name: Johnny Bee
items.text: We had In The Light Roofing do a new roof for us. This is an amazing company, everyone that we had any contact with was very professional from top to bottom. They were always on time, the work was exceptional and the clean-up afterwards was great. I would highly recommend them if you need any roofing work. Thank you everyone at In The Light.

items.name: Kat Hinkle
items.text: I had a "drip" for years which, eventually, turned into Niagara Falls. I desperately needed immediate help. In The Light Roofing took care of it quickly and efficiently! They also took care of me, as I am a special needs customer, and I told them about my condition. The workers were knowledgeable and FAST, and the price was extremely reasonable, way under what I was expecting; they even helped me with financing! Yesterday, day #1 since the repair was completed, we had torrential rain. The roof is 100% perfect! I give this company my highest recommendations (and I am fussy)! Oh, and I foretold them about my 3 large, friendly dogs, and they were kind and compassionate towards them, also!

items.name: Nathan “cappydoo”
items.text: After noticing multiple leaks forming in my my 23+ year old roof and have numerous companies come and give estimates on work no one was more a pleasure then In the light roofing. Having never been in the situation of needing a new roof before until now the process was extremely easy due to the hassle free and straight forward employees involved. From getting an inspection and estimate to the crew who installed/ cleaned up the outside of my home. They take great pride and integrity in the work they do fixing issues that other companies may have skipped over. Their price was very fair for the quality of work they provide as i had two companies give quotes lower and higher then In The Light Roofing. Overall very impressed and will tell friends and family to use them in the future.

items.name: Abbe Ames
items.text: At no point in my experience with this company was I ever disappointed. From the moment John came out to give me an estimate to the completion of the job, I was always impressed with the knowledge, integrity, work ethic, competency, and true kindness that everyone demonstrated. All of my questions were answered to my satisfaction. There were no hidden fees or surprises at the end of the job. I am thrilled with my new roof and would absolutely recommend this company to anyone needing any kind of roofing services.

items.name: Matthew Zmarzley
items.text: Bryson and his Team provide quality work for a reasonable price. They were both friendly and fast completing the job at my home while demonstrating professionalism from start to finish. Highly recommend them for your roofing needs.

items.name: Carol Fenstermaker Wolf
items.text: If you need a new roof, this is the company to hire. I rate them a perfect 10. expert craftsmanship, courteous, efficient, competitive with price. Cannot praise them enough!

items.name: Paul Heric
items.text: The In the Light Roofing crew just completed a new roof installation on our home. The experience was top notch from the first phone call to the final product. The job was challenging due to the roof configuration but the crew handled it like pros. The communication was frequent and thoughtful. There were some delays in getting materials and Johnathan kept us up to date and informed on progress, only scheduling the install when all the materials were in hand. As with any large project unexpected issues arise. This group addressed all concerns and questions professionally, without any hassle, to be sure the job was done right and that we were totally satisfied. The customer truly comes first at ITL roofing. In this world of getting what you pay for, we truly got a quality job, done right, for a reasonable price. Gladly recommend this organization.

items.name: Joe Roth
items.text: Great company. Very easy to work with. They kept me updated on the process and timing. Worked with my insurance company to make sure I didn't have any extra out of pocket costs, and even changed some lightbulbs I couldn't reach while they were up there. Highly recommended.

items.name: Chelsey Lynn
items.text: We were more than happy with our new roof from In The Light! From start to finish they had patience with explaining step by step what the process would like look - from materials to timeline to getting the roof completed, we felt very confident in the team. Adam helped to schedule the appt and went through pricing. John was able to give us a detailed run down. Bryson was out with the team day of to install the roof. The quality was great and the clean up was tremendous too. Our biggest concern was making sure everything was picked up because of the dogs but they didn’t disappoint. Highly recommend Bryson and his team for anyone looking to get their roof redone! Thanks again!

items.name: Lisa Schadt
items.text: There are many steps involved in getting estimates, contracts, and getting projects under way and finished. Our experience, having three roofs replaced/ repaired, was outstanding in every way. Adam and Bryson were exceptionally pleasant to work with, responsive, professional and a breath of fresh air. The price was fair, and the work excellent. They kept us updated with photos, as the work was progressing, and they went the extra mile. We could not be more pleased, and they have my highest recommendation.

items.name: Lori Frankenfield Hines
items.text: Wanted to take the time to speak on an experience I have had with a local roofing company. In the light roofing, came and gave us an estimate for some minor roof repairs. They could have covered it up and walked away, we would have never known the difference. However they did the right thing and let us know. They did all the repairs the correct way and for that I am grateful. In the light roofing, you are number one in our book!
